column8: Wed 18 Nov: 3a: Q126-036's quoted words are the 2015 and 2016 State of Florida CAFRs' own, exact; the CAFR calls it a target, so quote it as the state's summary and pair it with row 2's minutes.

Wed 18 Nov: 3a and 3f outside example: the Board's own 7 Dec 2006 minutes limit the equity segment to the reserve or 15%, whichever is less; cite them as Q126-036's primary source, never as the team's reason (IPS l.9, CANON A3).
Wed 18 Nov: 3a: the only source for June 2006 is a copy site of the 2012 annual report; Q126-036's from June 2006 rests on it, while the minutes (row 2) prove only by 7 Dec 2006.

Wed 18 Nov: 3a: the 15% cap is gone (70% of the reserve in FY2024, up to 70% in FY2025), so Q126-036 must be told in the past tense, from June 2006; the line between promised and spare money survives, which is the point.

Wed 18 Nov: 3a disanalogy: Florida's matched book had the state's guarantee behind it; Laura's ten have only Treasuries she owns, which is why they are owned outright; whether the guarantee was ever drawn is unread.
Wed 18 Nov: 3a usable form of rows 1-5: keep Q126-036's aha, cite the 2006 minutes, add since loosened to up to 70% of the surplus, never the matched money; the rule outlived its number.
Wed 18 Nov: 3d: Taiwan's statutory climate report (2024, Box 3) prints an official Mandarin likelihood scale, the words a co-sponsor's translator meets; the 31 Aug 2026 revised edition is unchecked.
Wed 18 Nov: 3d store: Taiwan's list and the IPCC's Chinese differ on very likely and very unlikely; supports giving co-sponsors figures, not hedge words; translator detail, not report prose.

Wed 18 Nov: 3c and 3d: Taiwan's own official list prints the everyday word for impossible for unlikely, so Q128-002's trap is Taiwanese too; say downsides as figures, never as unlikely, in Laura's words.
Wed 18 Nov: store hygiene: corrects card Q128's claim 1 verdict; Q128-013 stands for the Delta foundation's translation only, never Taiwan has no official word list.
Wed 18 Nov: 3c store, extends Q128-014: confidence has many official Taiwanese renderings, so the case's confidence level has no fixed Mandarin word; the stated range with certain needs none.

Wed 18 Nov: 3c: in Taiwan's official texts the confidence word also names a 90% or 95% test, a reason in the co-sponsors' own language for 3c's rule: no 95% or confidence interval label, certain on the stated range.
Wed 18 Nov: 3d store: the national report once puts a likelihood word inside a confidence label; one passage, a slip; backs one plain word for the translator, adds little beyond rows 8 and 11.

Wed 18 Nov: 3c and 3d: in Taiwan's climate service a likely range is a band that misses one time in three; Laura's range after the move is owned, not a band, so never call it a likely range in any language.

Wed 18 Nov: 3c parallel: Taiwan's climate service puts no confidence word on a model range; mirrors certain said only of the stated range after the move, never of a model figure; a method choice, not a rule.
Wed 18 Nov: 3d: official Taiwanese texts carry the English word in brackets, so in a Mandarin retelling certain may travel as is, with the figures in US dollars; a science habit, not donor practice.
Wed 18 Nov: CANON B15 and 3e area (1): J.P. Morgan's 7.5% read live and unrevised; closes Q117-001's open re-read of a cached copy; said as above the middle of published forecasts.
Wed 18 Nov: Table 2's references: PGIM's own ACWI figure is 6.25%, so Q6b-015's 6.3 Keel blend can cite PGIM's number; panel order and every median unchanged.
Wed 18 Nov: panel guard: PGIM's 7.80% is a steady-state figure beyond ten years; any recount takes each house's ten-year table only, or a false house lands above J.P. Morgan.

Wed 18 Nov: 3e area (1): rechecked at source 18 Nov: the PDF's ACWI row reads 6.2, 7.4, 7.6 under the legend EUR GBP USD (cash 2.4, 3.6, 3.8 fits), geometric nominal, ten years, data to 30 Sep 2026; hedged or unhedged not stated; a seventeenth house above J.P. Morgan.

Wed 18 Nov: arithmetic checked (6.5 = 8th of 15, AQR; 6.7 of 16; 6.9 = 9th of 17, Northern Trust; 4, 5, 6 above J.P. Morgan); keep above the middle of published forecasts, but the bare (median about 6.5%) in SKELETON l.47 and l.100, exhibits/tables.md l.13, NUMBERS l.2276 and l.2342, CANON l.126 (B15), ROUND2_WORKER_BRIEF l.48 and CLAUDE.md l.4 becomes median about 6.5% of the fifteen houses (as tables.md l.90 already says) or goes; not between about 6.5% and 7%, since Q117-007's aggregator houses put a twenty-house median near 6.45; NUMBERS 8p's thirteen of fifteen reads fifteen of seventeen only if the panel widens.

Wed 18 Nov: 3e and Table 2's references: BlackRock's 9.0 is June data and its 30 Sep figure is unread (charts only); the seventeen-house median moves only if it falls below 6.9; read the spreadsheet before Thu 3 Dec.
Wed 18 Nov: twin of Q117-009 (one-year targets never enter a ten-year panel); adds Morgan Stanley's 16 Nov targets, read only on a news site (UNVERIFIED).
Wed 18 Nov: twin of Q6b-016: Vanguard's 30 Sep 2026 run is still the latest; the next lands after the deadline.

Wed 18 Nov: 3e: a house's own range leaves out the chance its model is wrong (EFG: volatility only, no parameter uncertainty); the stated range after the move rests on Treasuries owned, not a model band; EFG's ACWI figure still unread.
Wed 18 Nov: twin of Q117-012 a day later (IBTM $641.4m on 17 Nov, 15 holdings, spread 0.05%, no notice); if CANON B22 prints a size, print the newest with its date.
Wed 18 Nov: twin of Q45-017 (IBTR size and 0.04% spread); $116.3m on 17 Nov, about 3.4% up in a day (checked), nothing new for liquid.
Wed 18 Nov: final-check guard: ishares.com served IBTM at 23 Oct data while blackrock.com showed 17 Nov; read each fund figure's as-of date; NUMBERS l.87 is correctly dated 23 Oct, no change.

Wed 18 Nov: Table 3 row 5: IBTR's 0.16% premium sits inside the trade-day limit of 0.5% of net asset value, not inside the payments' 0.5% margin: NUMBERS 4 (Not the haircut, l.530-532) puts a fill's distance outside both ends and charges a purchase premium to the 2028 deposit's first dollars; the 0.09% is NUMBERS 4 l.524, citing section 0.
Wed 18 Nov: twin of Q117-018: no Treasury iBond closure, merger or moved end since August; nothing to act on in Table 3's fund-notices row.
Wed 18 Nov: twin of Q117-011: VT's 30 Sep 2026 fact sheet is still the latest; row 32 carries the newer dated count.
Wed 18 Nov: CANON B12-B13 (l.123-124): print 10,185 only with 30 Sep 2026, or 10,158 with 31 Oct 2026; the TNA's about 10,000 holds; corrects Q117-011's no dates on the advisor page.
Wed 18 Nov: twin of Q117-022: 17 Nov close 0.20-0.29 points above 6 Nov at every tenor (checked against the repo's 6 Nov CSV); context only, the register stays on 6 Nov.
Wed 18 Nov: final-check guard only: Treasury's year file lagged the month file by a day; read the month file for the last close; serves no report part.
Wed 18 Nov: twin of Q117-019: NT$32.850 on 17 Nov, 0.25% weaker than NUMBERS 8d's 32.768 (checked); context only, Table 3 row 7 measures from 2031.
Wed 18 Nov: twin of Q10c-019: October CPI +2.33% still the latest; no November release before the deadline.

Wed 18 Nov: Table 3's note: October 2026 is the last building-cost month before submission, but recent months may be revised for three months, so never call October's 120.50 final; the 7-8 Dec date rests on an aggregator.
